{{Icon|Cryo Susceptibility icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Cryo Susceptibility]] is a type of debuff inflicted to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When enemies are inflicted with '''Cryo Susceptibility''', they temporarily take more {{Color|Cryo DMG|4}}. The number represents the degree of increase.

<math>\text{Susceptibility Multiplier} = \sum\text{Susceptibility Effect} \times \text{Susceptibility Multiplier Effect}</math>

Multiple sources of Cryo Susceptibility, as well as {{G|Arts Susceptibility}}, stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Susceptibility Effect''' for that damage instance. {{Icon|Last Rite icon|[[Last Rite]]'s}} Talent {{Color|Cryogenic Embrittlement|7}} functions as a '''Susceptibility Effect Multiplier'''. It stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with the total Susceptibility Effect to determine the '''Susceptibility Multiplier'''. The Susceptibility Multiplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
